learning_outcomes.text: The student must learn the tools for solving practical problems; formulate the necessary models to study, analyze, and design heat exchange equipment; develop the ability to solve heat transfer problems using tools and methods typical of a broad-spectrum technical education.
The student must demonstrate knowledge and understanding of problems related to heat exchange according to the three mechanisms of heat transfer.
The student must demonstrate the ability to formulate the necessary models to study, analyze, and design heat exchange equipment.

syllabus_topics: Mass and energy balances for closed and open systems
Conduction: numerical methods for solving steady and unsteady temperature fields
Fundamental equations in the boundary layer
Correlations for evaluating local and average convective heat transfer coefficient

assessment_methods.method: Project work (group problem solving with Matlab, report, presentation, and discussion)

assessment_rules: The exam consists of a written test and an oral test. The written test can be passed via two midterm tests or a full test in one of the exam sessions. Students will also solve a heat exchange problem in groups using Matlab software, the results of which will be presented and discussed during the oral exam. Passing the written exam is mandatory for access to the oral exam. The final grade will take into account all aspects of the assessment.
